tenderSchedule.title: Inviting tenders for appointment of Internal Auditor
tenderSchedule.description: Inviting tenders for appointment of Internal Auditor
tenderSchedule.deptName: Karnataka State Small Industries Development Corporation Limited

tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
ALL TERMS AND CONDITIONS AS PER TENDER DOCUMENT

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The bidder should be a company registered under the companies Act, 1956/2013 or partnership firm as per partnership act 1932 and should have been in operation at least since last 5 years

Bidder must have taken up similar works and satisfactorily completed the Audit from departments of government of India in last three years relevant to the scope of work and business profile successfully implemented.
The Bidder should be a registered company and should have office in Bangalore dedicated to Accounting ventures a team of minimum 10 or more technically qualified staff
The bidding firm / company should have experience in working on at least 03 (Three) Years in public sector undertakings including web based ERP software.
The bidder should have an annual turnover of minimum Rs. 75 lakhs and above in any preceding three financial years. With positive net worth in each of the previous years
The bidder should not have been blacklisted by Government Departments/ organizations in Karnataka.
The bidder should have PAN / GST / ICAI registration certificate
The bidder should be a Chartered Account and in line of consultancy and support services.

tenderCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Knowledge of Kannada reading and reading is mandatory self attested.
